title: Recognise the Types of Requirements
description: An ancient scroll lists requirements scrambled with their categories. Match each requirement to the correct type to restore the scroll.

challenge_data.title: Match the requirement type
challenge_data.prompt: Drag each requirement onto the correct category.

pairs.requirement: The system shall respond to user input within 2 seconds.
pairs.explanation: Response time is a quality attribute, not a behaviour.

pairs.requirement: Users shall be able to register with email and password.
pairs.explanation: Describes a specific capability the system must provide.

pairs.requirement: All stored user data shall be encrypted using AES-256.
pairs.explanation: A constraint on how data is handled, not a behaviour.

pairs.requirement: The interface shall be available in English and Latvian.
pairs.explanation: Localisation is a quality concern affecting accessibility.

title: Identify the Stakeholders
description: A village is split by who needs what. Match each viewpoint to the right stakeholder.

challenge_data.title: Match the stakeholder concern
challenge_data.prompt: Drag each concern onto the stakeholder it belongs to.

pairs.requirement: Cares mainly about return on investment and total cost.
pairs.explanation: Funding decision-makers focus on value and budget.

pairs.requirement: Wants the daily task to be fast and not error-prone.
pairs.explanation: End users live with the friction of the system every day.

pairs.requirement: Worries about audit logs, data retention and GDPR.
pairs.explanation: Regulatory roles enforce legal and policy constraints.

pairs.requirement: Needs the system to integrate cleanly with the existing CRM.
pairs.explanation: Ops cares about deployment, maintenance and integration.

title: Prioritise the Backlog
description: The Cave Council needs to ship in three months. Help them sort which requirements are Must, Should, Could, or Won't.

challenge_data.title: MoSCoW prioritisation
challenge_data.prompt: Drag each requirement onto its priority class.

pairs.requirement: Users must be able to recover a forgotten password.
pairs.explanation: Without account recovery the product is unusable.

pairs.requirement: The app should send a daily reminder push notification.
pairs.explanation: Important for engagement but the product still works without it.

pairs.requirement: Users could customise the colour theme of the UI.
pairs.explanation: Nice to have, adds polish, low priority for launch.

pairs.requirement: The system will integrate with a VR headset.
pairs.explanation: Explicitly out of scope for this release.
